title: Luv & Lee
oneLiner: The student magazine of the Faculty of Design in Würzburg, three issues as part of the head team.

cover.alt: The magazine issue Hau Ruck! lies on a dark stone block: a black cover with white lettering and a glass hammer.

facts.Context: student magazine, Faculty of Design, University of Applied Sciences Würzburg
facts.Role: head team member for three issues: Tatütata, Soft Matter, Hau Ruck!
facts.Tools: graphic design, art direction, print preparation

sections.label: Magazine
text: Luv & Lee has been published at the Faculty of Design for over eleven years. Students can express themselves on a changing theme, and the free works are printed in a collected magazine. The head team sets the topic and design framework, supervises the contributors and organizes the printing.

media.alt: Cover of the issue Soft Matter, Luv & Lee issue 14: white lettering on a yellow-green and white pattern, lying on a dark surface.

sections.label: Three issues
text: I was part of the head team for three issues. Besides supervising contributors and planning the print process with the printing house, I made my own contributions: for Tatütata a collaboration with a kindergarten, where children painted what they associate with the word, plus objects in warning colors and vest patterns; for Soft Matter "Artificial Sunset", a visualization of weather data and light pollution of different cities; for Hau Ruck! a 3D animation with glass that can be activated via AR.

media.alt: Collage of magazine pages: a newspaper-style spread with stickers, a spread with a round photograph, the Hau Ruck! cover seen through a phone with an AR animation, and a black spread with yellow lines.
